en.quote: …on taxes, we discussed the issue last year [in 2024] and agreed that, as a baseline, we would leave taxes unchanged.
en.head: VAT rose to 22% the following year.
en.body: In June 2025 Siluanov described a provisional understanding to leave taxes broadly unchanged. In November, Putin signed a law raising the main VAT rate from 20% to 22% on 1 January 2026. This was a later change in tax policy; it does not establish that a rise had already been decided in June.
en.meta_context: St. Petersburg International Economic Forum, Sberbank breakfast

osrc.t: Federal Tax Service, Law No. 425-FZ and the 2026 VAT rate
